description: PLATEAU's underground building group fixture (Z-common-01_xlink_01) with the uro:UndergroundBuilding, and so its rooms, filtered out before the writer. The group is still written, and its grp:groupMember and grp:parent links are kept as given, naming gml:ids no object in the document has; the writer reports citygml.link_target_not_written and gives no other element those ids. New-world only: the legacy writer does not nest objects and does not write groups.
